name: Holzfarm
description: German online shop for wooden toys, children's books, creative supplies and gift ideas. Its shipping page lists Germany, Austria, Italy, Belgium, France, Spain and the Netherlands.
description_es: Tienda online alemana de juguetes de madera, libros infantiles, artículos creativos e ideas de regalo. Su página de envíos incluye Alemania, Austria, Italia, Bélgica, Francia, España y Países Bajos.

ships_to.notes: Free shipping within Germany from 50 EUR order value, otherwise 3.99 EUR. No regional limits stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup is not mentioned on the shipping page.

shopping_notes: Product pages in German. Other countries on request by email.

sources.supports: delivery countries and German shipping terms
